source: Ministry of Economy & Tourism workplace questionnaire (HR).

instructions.ar: اقرأ كل عبارة واختر مدى انطباقها عليك في العمل. لا توجد إجابات صحيحة أو خاطئة، فأجب بصدق ودون تفكير طويل.
instructions.en: Read each statement and choose how well it describes you at work. There are no right or wrong answers, so answer honestly and without long thought.

items.en: I create plans before starting important tasks.
items.ar: أضع خطة قبل البدء في المهام المهمة.

items.en: I pay close attention to details.
I meet deadlines consistently.
I keep my work organized.
I follow through on commitments.
I feel comfortable meeting new people.
items.ar: أشعر بالارتياح عند التعرف على أشخاص جدد.

items.en: I enjoy speaking in front of groups.
I like collaborating with others.
I feel energized when working with people.
items.ar: أشعر بالنشاط عند العمل مع الناس.

items.en: I often take the lead in discussions.
I listen carefully to others' opinions.
I am willing to help colleagues when needed.
items.ar: أنا مستعد لمساعدة زملائي عند الحاجة.

items.en: I try to avoid unnecessary conflict.
items.ar: أحرص على تجنب الخلافات غير الضرورية.

items.en: People describe me as cooperative.
I consider the impact of my actions on others.
I remain calm under pressure.
I recover quickly from setbacks.
I make decisions without excessive worry.
I stay focused during stressful situations.
I handle criticism constructively.
I enjoy learning new skills.
I welcome new ideas and approaches.
I like solving unfamiliar problems.
I adapt quickly to change.
I seek opportunities for continuous improvement.
